notes: POC focused on repository-aware completions inside IDE (VSCode). Wants embeddings per-repo + vector DB to surface file & symbol context. Primary ask: low-latency streaming completions (first token <50ms ideally, token inter-arrival <25ms) while preserving high-quality completions. Interested in model/version pinning — pin to small low-latency tuned model for completion, fallback to larger model for complex refactors. Stated on call: "If completions feel slow (>200ms) engineers abandon the flow". Data residency requirement: US-only for customer repos, and ability to keep vectors in VPC. Encryption: KMS + HSM for secret material; audit logs required. Cost sensitivity: wants to compare hosted API vs Dedicated capacity for predictable cost at 50k monthly active completions. Prefers embeddings workflow that supports incremental updates (per-commit hooks), chunking at function+docstring level, 50% overlap, and ability to exclude binary blobs. Vector DB preferences: compatibility with Milvus or Pinecone; open to Redwood-managed vector store if residency/VPC guaranteed. Asked for routing rules: pin model by team, fallback to quantized variant on Dedicated when under load. Next: final security questionnaire, then infra scoping meeting to map network egress and KMS integration.

technical_requirements: Repository-aware retrieval: vector index per repo with path+symbol metadata
Embeddings cadence: incremental (post-commit hook) and full repo re-index weekly
Chunking: function-level primary; fallback token-based for large files; 50% overlap target
Vector DB: support for Milvus/Pinecone or Redwood-managed VPC-backed vector store
Latency targets: first-token <50ms for IDE completions, sustained streaming under 25ms token inter-arrival
Throughput targets: 500 qps peak for completions during internal load tests; 50 concurrent real-time users
Model preferences: pin to redwood-2-7b-quant (or similar) for baseline; auto-fallback to redwood-4-medium for complex queries
Routing/fallback: region-aware routing (US primary) with graceful fallback to less costly variant under capacity pressure
Security/integration: SSO/SAML, customer KMS, HSM-backed key storage, audit logs with 1-year retention
Data residency: vectors and derived embeddings must remain in customer VPC (US only) for production POC
Observability: per-request cost & latency breakdown, per-model error rates, per-repo metrics
